;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[United States Armed Forces]] open fire and kill a [[Syrians|Syrian]] after a group of [[Syrian government|government]] supporters attempted to block a [[United States|U.S.]] [[convoy]] in protest at a [[security checkpoint|checkpoint]] near [[Qamishli]], [[Al-Hasakah Governorate]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/syria-us-troops-open-fire-on-locals-in-northeast-killing-1/ar-BBZV6CW (MSN)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-51477229 (BBC News)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Pope Francis]] rules against [[ordain]]ing married men as [[priest]]s, a possible measure to counter the shortage of [[Catholic priest]]s. He also ruled against allowing [[Ordination of women and the Catholic Church|women to be ordained]] as [[deacon]]s. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-51474009 (BBC News)]
*The [[Ministry of Culture (Colombia)|Ministry of Culture of Colombia]] designates the [[Spanish galleon San José|Spanish galleon ''San José'']] as an asset of cultural interest, thus protecting it from commercial exploitation. [https://noticias.canalrcn.com/nacional/galeon-san-jose-es-declarado-como-bien-de-interes-cultural-por-el-gobierno-352661 (RCN)]

;Business and economy
*The [[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights]] publishes a list of 112 companies linked to activities related to [[Israeli settlement]]s in the [[Israeli occupation of the West Bank|occupied West Bank]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-51477231 (BBC News)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/issues-report-firms-active-illegal-west-bank-settlements-200212162025947.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**The [[United States Postal Service]] suspends time guarantees for all shipments to [[China]] and [[Hong Kong]]. [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/article/3050103/coronavirus-us-postal-service-suspends-items-destined-china-and-hong (''South China Morning Post'')]
**The [[GSM Association]] decides to cancel this year's [[Mobile World Congress]] in [[Barcelona]], [[Spain]], amid coronavirus concerns. The event would have been held between February 24 and 27. This is the first time that the [[Mobile telephony|mobile communications]] trade show has been cancelled. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/02/12/mwc-mobile-world-congress-canceled-amid-coronavirus-fears.html (CNBC)] 
**[[MS Westerdam|MS ''Westerdam'']], with more than two thousand people on board, is finally granted permission to disembark in [[Cambodia]] after several countries deny it permission. [https://eu.usatoday.com/story/travel/cruises/2020/02/12/coronavirus-and-cruises-cambodia-allows-holland-america-ship-dock/4728403002/ (''USA Today'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[Tonga]] refuses entry to four [[cruise ship]]s due to health warnings following the pandemic. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/409356/coronavirus-4-cruise-ships-refused-entry-into-tonga (RNZ)]

;Law and crime
*[[Nissan]] begins a {{USD|90}}{{nbsp}}million lawsuit against its former chairman [[Carlos Ghosn]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2020/feb/12/nissan-launches-lawsuit-against-former-chairman-carlos-ghosn (''The Guardian'')]
*More than half of [[Malta]]'s [[Traffic police|traffic police officers]], including its chief, are arrested for overtime fraud and misuse of public resources. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-malta-fraud/more-than-half-maltas-traffic-police-arrested-for-fraud-idUSKBN2060ZD?il=0 (Reuters)]
*Trial of [[Maesiah Thabane]]
**[[Lesotho]] begins a murder investigation of First Lady Maesiah Thabane for the [[murder]] of former first lady [[Lipolelo Thabane]] and ex-wife of Prime Minister [[Tom Thabane]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/02/12/africa/lesotho-pm-wife-murder-probe-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*The [[United States Department of Education|U.S. Department of Education]] launches an investigation into [[Harvard University|Harvard]] and [[Yale University|Yale]] for allegedly accepting billions of dollars in undisclosed gifts from numerous foreign governments, including those from [[Saudi Arabia]], China, and [[Russia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-51481396 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries|2020 U.S. Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**Former [[Massachusetts]] [[Governor of Massachusetts|governor]] [[Deval Patrick]] suspends [[Deval Patrick 2020 presidential campaign|his presidential campaign]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/massachusetts-gov-deval-patrick-suspends-presidential-bid/story?id=67498712 (ABC News)]
**[[Iowa Democratic Party]] chairman [[Troy Price]] resigns for his handling of this year's [[2020 Iowa Democratic caucuses|Iowa caucuses]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/02/12/politics/troy-price-iowa-resigns/index.html (CNN)]
*The [[Senate of Italy|Italian Senate]] allows former [[Ministry of the Interior (Italy)|Minister of the Interior]] and current senator [[Matteo Salvini]] to be tried in a criminal case for illegally detaining [[immigration to Italy|migrants]] last summer. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51473239 (BBC News)]

;Science and technology
*[[Brazilians|Brazilian]] scientists announce the discovery of a new [[Amoeba|amoebic]] "Yaravirus" in [[Lake Pampulha]]. The strain was found to be significantly smaller than any known amoebic virus, and 90% of its genome appears to be genes that have never been seen before in any life-form. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/science/virus-no-genes-yaravirus-brazil-federal-university-minas-gerais-a9325931.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2020.01.28.923185v1 (bioRxiv)] [https://www.sciencemag.org/news/2020/02/scientists-discover-virus-no-recognizable-genes (''Science magazine'')]
*[[WhatsApp]] hits two billion users, becoming the second largest [[social media]] platform in terms of userbase behind [[Facebook]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-whatsapp-users/whatsapp-users-cross-2-billion-second-only-to-facebook-idUSKBN20626L?il=0 (Reuters)]
